note: Small CPW campground along the southern edge of East Rifle Creek below the park's triple 60-foot waterfall, about 14 miles from I-70 at Rifle via CO 13 and CO 325. The walk-in tent sites (014-020) sit closest to the creek and have bear-proof food boxes. Nearest dump station is at Rifle Gap State Park, whose visitor center also serves Rifle Falls. --Claude
